concerns.text: The `SurveyResponse` entity defined in `data-model.md` includes the field `proxy_validated` (boolean), but `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` does not list this field in its `required` or `properties` sections. This creates a mismatch: the ingestion step validates raw/parquet files against the dataset contract, yet downstream code expects `proxy_validated` to be present in cleaned rows. Align the contract with the data model (add `proxy_validated` with appropriate description) or remove the field from the data model if it is not part of the cleaned dataset schema.
